title: Planet of the Apes
short: Ten films, two continuities, one time loop
blurb: The original series travels backwards in time to cause its own beginning. The modern films restart from scratch and run forwards.

a70.t: Beneath the Planet of the Apes

a71.t: Escape from the Planet of the Apes

a73.t: Battle for the Planet of the Apes

a17.t: War for the Planet of the Apes

a24.t: Kingdom of the Planet of the Apes

note: This is the hardest order on the site and nobody agrees on it. The original five form a closed loop — apes travel back to 1973 and cause the future they came from — so any chronological run is arbitrary at the seam. The modern four are a separate continuity, and the 2001 film is its own thing. Release order is strongly recommended.
